storedHere.switchLabel: Keep a search index on this computer
storedHere.switchCaption: Lets search find words inside every document. It holds file paths, modified times and each document's words in a searchable form, not a readable copy, in this computer's cache folder, and never leaves it. Anyone who can open that file can check which documents contain a word.

storedHere.offCaption: Off. Search covers titles, summaries and tags, and no index file exists.
